summary: Tested Unified Invite Page and Collapsible Sidebar features. All 8 backend tests PASSED. All frontend UI components verified working. Both features fully implemented and working correctly.

Backend: test_02_create_invitation_with_name_properties_permissions - POST accepts name, assigned_properties, permissions
Backend: test_03_invitations_list_after_create - GET returns invitations with dynamically computed status
Backend: test_04_resend_invitation_generates_new_token - POST /api/invitations/{id}/resend generates new token
Backend: test_05_cancel_invitation - PUT /api/invitations/{id}/cancel sets status to cancelled
Backend: test_06_cannot_resend_cancelled_invitation - Resend fails for cancelled invitations
Backend: test_07_create_owner_invitation - POST creates owner invitation correctly
Backend: test_08_status_columns_in_response - GET returns all required table columns
Frontend: Sidebar shows 'Invite' nav item (not 'Invitations')
Frontend: Sidebar toggle button (data-testid='sidebar-toggle-btn') present
Frontend: Sidebar collapses from 240px to 64px when toggle clicked

Frontend: Collapsed state persists after page navigation

Frontend: Invite page loads correctly (data-testid='invite-page')
Frontend: Status filter tabs present (All, Pending, Accepted, Expired, Cancelled) with badges
Frontend: Table shows all required columns (Name, Email, Role, Properties, Status, Sent, Expires, Actions)
Frontend: Send Invitation button present (data-testid='send-invitation-btn')
Frontend: Send dialog has Role select (data-testid='invite-role-select')
Frontend: Send dialog has Person picker (data-testid='invite-person-select')
Frontend: Send dialog has Name input (data-testid='invite-name-input')
Frontend: Send dialog has Email input (data-testid='invite-email-input')
Frontend: Send dialog has Properties multi-select (data-testid='invite-properties-list')
Frontend: Send dialog has Staff permissions section (data-testid='invite-permissions')
Frontend: Send dialog has confirm button (data-testid='confirm-send-invitation-btn')
Frontend: Resend button works and shows toast 'New invitation sent! Previous link invalidated.'
Frontend: Cancel button works and shows toast 'Invitation cancelled'

invite_page_table_columns.details: All 8 required columns: Name, Email, Role, Properties, Status, Sent, Expires, Actions
